name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina Volkov's motorsport journey began unexpectedly after she volunteered at a local karting track as a translator for a visiting Italian team. Fascinated by the technical intricacies and the relentless pursuit of performance, she quickly immersed herself in the world of racing. Over the years, Irina honed her skills in coordinating test sessions, managing driver feedback, and ensuring optimal communication between drivers, engineers, and mechanics.

As a test driver coordinator, Irina is known for her meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to detail. She believes that thorough preparation and clear communication are essential for successful testing outcomes. Her loyalty and dedication have earned her the respect of drivers and team members alike. Irina is always striving to improve testing methodologies, leveraging data-driven insights to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of each session. She is a perfectionist, always pushing for incremental gains and seeking innovative solutions to optimize vehicle performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves.
physical.description: Irina has a warm smile and a thoughtful expression, reflecting her meticulous and dedicated nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations during test sessions.
Has a habit of meticulously organizing the testing schedule with color-coded markers.
Insists on having a cup of black tea before every debriefing session.
